item.title: Descript: Brand Design Lead
item.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote, US

About the Role

Descript helps creators and companies tell stories through video. The creative team ensures that our brand lives up to the ethos of our customers. We ship work that’s brave, creative, and a bit uncomfortable, pushing with conviction where human creativity matters.

As the Brand Design Lead, you will evolve the brand as you create for campaigns, web experiences, and events. You’ll move between big picture concepting, building brand systems, and designing with an expert level of craft. Reporting to the Director of Brand & Content, you will be trusted and supported to create daring work that reminds people of the joy of telling stories.

What You'll Do

  • Set a high bar and execute work that exceeds it
    • Evolve and extend the Descript brand to show up well in campaigns, web, and events
    • Lead concept and design for launches and campaigns, from brief through delivery
  • Build a brand system that scales
    • Develop brand systems and toolkits that allow the work to scale in expected (and some unexpected) ways
    • Enable product, marketing, and sales partners to create on-brand assets without relying on you

item.title: Stripe: Account Executive, Product Sales - Tax
item.description:
Headquarters: US-Remote

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in the Stripe portfolio. Revenue suite Product Sales is tasked with pursuing a $100B market opportunity for back-office finance automation across billing, tax, revenue reporting, and data.
